function tcpoSrcMake(kind,i){const k=kind+'|'+i;if(TCPO.src.has(k))return;tcpoOut(()=>{const cv=document.createElement('canvas');TCSHOW.poster(cv,kind,i);
 const o=document.createElement('canvas');o.width=240;o.height=360;const g=o.getContext('2d');g.imageSmoothingQuality='high';g.drawImage(cv,0,0,240,360);TCPO.src.set(k,{cv:o});TCPO.n.src++})}
function tcpoWarm(){if(TCPO.warm)return;TCPO.warm=1;let Q=[];try{Q=TCSHOW.FILMS.map((f,i)=>['film',i]).concat(TCSHOW.PLAYS.map((p,i)=>['play',i]))}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}
 const step=()=>{if(typeof WTC!=='undefined'&&WTC&&WTC.extracting){setTimeout(step,60);return}const q=Q.shift();if(q){try{tcpoSrcMake(q[0],q[1])}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}setTimeout(step,40);return}
  TCPO.ready=true;TCPO.warm=2;try{BLD40.clear()}catch(e){}try{wtcInvalidate()}catch(e){}};setTimeout(step,200)}
// the pictures in their sizes: in a cache of their own (LRU, 6 MB) — not in the shared one of the brands, so they never push out the brands' pictures
// (the bus ads are drawn from it in every frame) and are never pushed out by them
TCPO.pics=new Map();TCPO.picB=0;
function tcpoCached(key,w,h,fn){w=Math.max(2,Math.round(w));h=Math.max(2,Math.round(h));const k=key+'|'+w+'x'+h;let e=TCPO.pics.get(k);if(e){TCPO.pics.delete(k);TCPO.pics.set(k,e);return e}
 const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=w;cv.height=h;fn(cv.getContext('2d'),w,h);e={cv,w,h};TCPO.pics.set(k,e);TCPO.picB+=w*h*4;TCPO.n.pics=(TCPO.n.pics||0)+1;
 while(TCPO.picB>6*1048576&&TCPO.pics.size>1){const [k0,e0]=TCPO.pics.entries().next().value;TCPO.pics.delete(k0);TCPO.picB-=e0.w*e0.h*4}return e}
function tcpoPic(kind,i,w,h){const S=tcpoSrc(kind,i);if(!S)return null;return tcpoOut(()=>tcpoCached('po|'+kind+'|'+i,TCB.bucket(Math.max(4,w)),TCB.bucket(Math.max(6,h)),(g,W,H)=>{g.imageSmoothingQuality='high';g.drawImage(S.cv,0,0,W,H)}))}
// the museum's banners: the new exhibition and the nature collection, drawn in code (a gradient, an emblem, the title, the line)
const TCPO_MUS={'תערוכה חדשה':{t:'מהים אל העיר',s:'תערוכה חדשה · איך נבנו הנמל, המסילה והשדה',a:'#0d2340',b:'#1f4f7a',c:'#f2c45a',em:'harbor'},
 'אוסף הטבע':{t:'אוסף הטבע',s:'22 מיני דגים מהאגם ומהחוף · תרמו את הדג שלכם',a:'#0c3b3a',b:'#1d7f74',c:'#bff2e0',em:'fish'}};
function tcpoBanner(key,w,h){const B=TCPO_MUS[key];return tcpoOut(()=>tcpoCached('pm|'+key,TCB.bucket(Math.max(8,w)),TCB.bucket(Math.max(8,h)),(g,W,H)=>{
 const G=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);G.addColorStop(0,B.b);G.addColorStop(1,B.a);g.fillStyle=G;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 g.save();g.globalAlpha=.9;g.strokeStyle=B.c;g.fillStyle=B.c;g.lineWidth=Math.max(1,H*.022);const ex=W*.5,ey=H*.34,u=Math.min(W,H)*.2;
 if(B.em==='fish'){for(const [dx,dy,s] of [[-1.3,-.2,.8],[0,.1,1],[1.3,-.15,.7]]){g.save();g.translate(ex+dx*u,ey+dy*u);g.scale(s,s);g.beginPath();g.ellipse(0,0,u*.62,u*.28,0,0,6.2832);g.fill();g.beginPath();g.moveTo(u*.55,0);g.lineTo(u*.95,-u*.28);g.lineTo(u*.95,u*.28);g.closePath();g.fill();g.fillStyle=B.a;g.beginPath();g.arc(-u*.36,-u*.05,u*.06,0,6.2832);g.fill();g.restore()}
  g.globalAlpha=.5;g.beginPath();for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=W/24){const y=ey+u*.75+Math.sin(x/W*12)*u*.08;x?g.lineTo(x,y):g.moveTo(x,y)}g.stroke()}
 else{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ex-u*1.6,ey+u*.7);g.lineTo(ex+u*1.6,ey+u*.7);g.stroke();g.fillRect(ex+u*.6,ey-u*.9,u*.14,u*1.6);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ex+u*.67,ey-u*.85);g.lineTo(ex-u*.9,ey-u*.85);g.lineTo(ex-u*.9,ey-u*.55);g.stroke();
  g.fillRect(ex-u*1.4,ey-u*.2,u*.5,u*.9);g.fillRect(ex-u*.75,ey+u*.05,u*.4,u*.65);g.beginPath();g.arc(ex-u*.2,ey-u*.75,u*.12,0,6.2832);g.fill()}   /* the crane, the stores, the lighthouse's light */
 g.restore();g.fillStyle=B.c;g.textAlign='center';g.textBaseline='middle';g.direction='rtl';let fs=Math.max(5,Math.min(H*.2,W*.16));g.font='800 '+fs+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial';
 while(fs>4&&g.measureText(B.t).width>W*.9){fs-=.5;g.font='800 '+fs+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial'}g.fillText(B.t,W/2,H*.68);
 let ss=Math.max(3.5,fs*.42);g.font='600 '+ss+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial';while(ss>3&&g.measureText(B.s).width>W*.94){ss-=.25;g.font='600 '+ss+'px "Segoe UI","Noto Sans Hebrew",Arial'}g.fillStyle='#f6efe0';g.fillText(B.s,W/2,H*.86);
 g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.55)';g.lineWidth=Math.max(1,W*.012);g.strokeRect(g.lineWidth,g.lineWidth,W-2*g.lineWidth,H-2*g.lineWidth)}))}

/* ---- 1 · the cinema (d2Face 'bld03'): the three frames by the doors — the posters of the evening's films ---- */
function tcpoCinema(c,N){const X=D2X,R=X.bld03,K=X.K,y1=R[3],k=tcbrPx(c);
 TCPO_FILMS.forEach((name,j)=>{const i=tcpoIdx('film',name);if(i<0)return;const px=R[0]+12+j*22,x=px,y=y1-K*43,w=16,h=K*34,e=tcpoPic('film',i,w*k,h*k);if(!e)return;c.drawImage(e.cv,x,y,w,h);
  c.strokeStyle='rgba(242,196,90,.8)';c.lineWidth=.5;c.strokeRect(x+.25,y+.25,w-.5,h-.5);TCPO.n.cinema++;TCPO.lit.set('cin'+j,{kind:'film',i,x,y,w,h})})}
function tcpoHookCinema(){if(TCPO.hookC||typeof d2Face!=='function'||typeof D2X==='undefined')return;const f=d2Face;
 d2Face=function(c,key,N){const r=f.apply(this,arguments);if(key==='bld03'&&TCPO.on){try{tcpoCinema(c,N)}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}}return r};TCPO.hookC=true}

/* ---- 2 · the museum (B5MUS) and the theatre (B5THEA) — inside the pictures of BLD40 (only while BLD40 makes a picture) ---- */
// the museum: each banner is a coloured rectangle and its word; the rectangle drawn just before the word is the banner — the designed banner
// goes in it, and the word is not written. The theatre: the marquee gets tonight's play; its four coloured rectangles (the poster places) get the
// four plays, from tonight's on, each in a dark light box of the rectangle's size (the poster's own shape inside). Each place is kept in the picture's
// units and, when the picture is made, put in the world by every building of that type and turn (for the night).
const TCPO_MARQ='הערב: המופע החדש',TCPO_SLOT={'#c0392b':0,'#7e57c2':1,'#2f6bb0':2,'#e67e22':3};
function tcpoTonight(){try{const P=TCSHOW.PLAYS;if(!P.length)return -1;let d=1;try{d=gameClock().day}catch(e){}return((d-1)%P.length+P.length)%P.length}catch(e){return -1}}   /* a play a day — by the day of the game clock (stadium 17.11; before: the real date, Date.now) */
function tcpoMark(g,key,q,x,y,w,h){const m=g.getTransform();TCPO.mk.marks.push(Object.assign({key,dx:m.a*x+m.c*y+m.e,dy:m.b*x+m.d*y+m.f,dw:w*m.a,dh:h*m.d},q))}
function tcpoPlayBox(g,j,x,y,w,h){const k=tcbrPx(g),ph=h-1.2,pw=Math.min(w-1.2,ph/1.5),px=x+(w-pw)/2,py=y+.6,e=tcpoPic('play',j,pw*k,ph*k);if(!e)throw new Error('no source');
 g.fillStyle='#17181c';g.fillRect(x,y,w,h);g.drawImage(e.cv,px,py,pw,ph);g.strokeStyle='rgba(242,196,90,.85)';g.lineWidth=.35;g.strokeRect(px,py,pw,ph);return [px,py,pw,ph]}
function tcpoCtx(g){if(g.__tcpo)return;g.__tcpo=1;const fr0=g.fillRect,ft0=g.fillText;let last=null;
 g.fillRect=function(x,y,w,h){const M=TCPO.mk;if(!M)return fr0.apply(this,arguments);const col=String(this.fillStyle).toLowerCase();
  if(M.id==='B5THEA'&&TCPO.on&&TCPO.ready&&TCPO_SLOT[col]!=null&&Math.abs(w-10)<.01){try{const n=TCSHOW.PLAYS.length,t=Math.max(0,tcpoTonight());if(n){const j=(t+TCPO_SLOT[col])%n,r=tcpoPlayBox(this,j,x,y,w,h);tcpoMark(this,'thea'+TCPO_SLOT[col],{kind:'play',i:j},...r);TCPO.n.theatre++;return}}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}}
  last={x,y,w,h,col};return fr0.apply(this,arguments)};
 g.fillText=function(t,x,y){const M=TCPO.mk;if(!M||!TCPO.on)return ft0.apply(this,arguments);try{
   if(M.id==='B5MUS'&&TCPO_MUS[t]&&last&&(last.col==='#7a2335'||last.col==='#2f4a6a')){const k=tcbrPx(this),e=tcpoBanner(t,last.w*k,last.h*k);this.drawImage(e.cv,last.x,last.y,last.w,last.h);tcpoMark(this,'mus'+(last.col==='#7a2335'?0:1),{kind:'banner',b:t},last.x,last.y,last.w,last.h);TCPO.n.museum++;return}
   if(M.id==='B5THEA'&&t===TCPO_MARQ){const i=tcpoTonight(),P=i>=0?TCSHOW.PLAYS[i]:null;return ft0.call(this,P?'הערב: '+P.name:t,x,y)}}catch(e){tcpoErr(e)}
   return ft0.apply(this,arguments)}}
// the places of a picture in the world: world = the building's (x, drawY) + the picture's units (BLD40.draw puts the picture at x − ox, y − oy)
function tcpoPlace(M,e){const L=new Set();for(const A of [typeof B4_BUILDINGS!=='undefined'?B4_BUILDINGS:[],typeof C4_BUILDINGS!=='undefined'?C4_BUILDINGS:[],typeof B5_BUILDINGS!=='undefined'?B5_BUILDINGS:[]])for(const o of A)L.add(o);
 for(const o of L){const b=o&&o.bld40;if(!b||b.type!==M.id||((b.rot|0)!==(M.rot|0)))continue;const X=o.x,Y=o.drawY!=null?o.drawY:o.y;
  for(const q of M.marks){const r=e.res||1;TCPO.lit.set(o.id+'|'+q.key,{kind:q.kind,i:q.i,b:q.b,x:X+q.dx/r-e.ox,y:Y+q.dy/r-e.oy,w:q.dw/r,h:q.dh/r})}}}
function tcpoHookB4(){if(TCPO.hookB||typeof BLD40==='undefined'||!BLD40||typeof BLD40.make!=='function')return;

  try{e=mk.apply(this,arguments)}finally{TCPO.mk=null}try{if(M.marks.length)tcpoPlace(M,e)}catch(err){tcpoErr(err)}return e};
 try{BLD40.clear()}catch(e){}TCPO.hookB=true}

/* ---- 3 · at night: the posters and the banners lit (after the night layer, in their place in the world) ---- */
function tcpoNight(){const d=tcbrDark();if(d<=.05||!(typeof WLD!=='undefined'&&WLD.on)||!TCPO.lit.size||!TCPO.on)return;const a=Math.min(.95,d*1.05),k=tcbrPx(ctx);let x0=-1e9,x1=1e9,y0=-1e9,y1=1e9;

 for(const q of TCPO.lit.values()){if(q.x+q.w<x0||q.x>x1||q.y+q.h<y0||q.y>y1)continue;const e=q.kind==='banner'?tcpoBanner(q.b,q.w*k,q.h*k):tcpoPic(q.kind,q.i,q.w*k,q.h*k);if(!e)continue;ctx.globalAlpha=a*.25;ctx.fillStyle='#fff1cf';ctx.fillRect(q.x-1.5,q.y-1.5,q.w+3,q.h+3);ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.drawImage(e.cv,q.x,q.y,q.w,q.h);TCPO.n.lit++}
 ctx.restore()}
